Holm-corrected over all ROI × signal tests.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: Signed RPE (red) · uRPE (green) · surprise (blue) · numbers mark the ROIs of a
Clusters smaller than 25 voxels are not given a row in a; the extents in the header are the full maps, so a signal can
be large here and absent from a (one confluent blob), or present as a map and too small to name.
